caption: The image shows a rectangular woven textile sample mounted on a plain light background. The textile features an alternating pattern of vertical blue tree-like shapes on a beige and rusty orange checkerboard background. The right half of the textile has larger blue geometric tree motifs, while the left half contains a denser repetition of smaller, similar blue shapes. Horizontal bands in blue and orange cross the top and bottom of the textile, forming a checkered and striped design. The bottom edge of the textile is finished with long, twisted fringe, predominantly blue but with a central section that is rusty orange.
title: Coverlet Detail
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
